cuts.head: tilt
cuts.placeText: a bridal dress shop — white gowns on mannequins, a fitting platform, a tall mirror and bolts of lace
cuts.scene: she is an apprentice kneeling on one knee to measure a hem with a tape, nervous about the numbers
cuts.outfit: a bridal seamstress look fitted to her body — a fitted silky sleeveless top and short flared skirt with a pincushion bracelet, bare shoulders and legs, a plain pincushion on her wrist
